<!-- en -->
v0.1.2 is the third stable release of token-usage. It consolidates every change shipped across v0.1.2-rc.1 and the seven commits after it; the prerelease is retired after this release, so this page is the authoritative record for v0.1.2. RC users can update in place with `token-usage update` (no `--version` needed).

### Highlights
- Configurable query views, no SQL required: combine `client`, `model`, `provider`, and `project` into named multi-dimensional subqueries (at least two dimensions; the declaration order is the column order), compose built-in views and subqueries into ordered report groups (at least two items, no nesting), and set a personal default view that the bare `token-usage query` runs
- Views run like built-in commands: `query <name> [date]` dispatches by positional argument (configured names never become dynamic subcommands), and `query custom <name> [date]` is the explicit equivalent — same target, same output, same validation
- `query list` is a static, read-only discovery command: it prints the default behavior, the six built-in commands, and every configured subquery and group as a copy-pasteable command with its dimensions or members; it reads the config only and never opens the usage database
- The config TUI gains a guided "Query views" page (press `v` in the main menu) for creating subqueries, groups, and the default view without writing CSV by hand; when the raw section cannot be parsed it first shows a recovery list where each item is fixed with `enter`
- Every query command now opens with a shared bilingual statistics header — the queried range, the latest message timestamp inside that range (`Data through`), and the most recent successful collection time — printed once even for multi-table groups; fields with no data show `—`
- Provider dimension (from v0.1.2-rc.1): `query provider` groups usage by provider, any custom view can include the provider dimension, and provider aliases are safe presentation-only mappings

### Changed
- `query.default` selects what the bare `query` runs; unconfigured it falls back to grouping by client. It may reference a built-in view, a subquery, or a group (`session` and `summary` are not referable). View names are lowercase identifiers that must not collide with `client`/`model`/`provider`/`project`/`session`/`summary`/`custom`/`list`
- Query configuration is display-only and fails localized: semantic errors (broken references, malformed CSV, unknown keys, top-level conflicts such as `[query]` alongside `[Query]`) reject only the default path, named invocations, `query list`, and TUI saves, with a message pointing at the offending key. The six static built-in views, `collect`, `status`, `start`, the daemon, `config set`, and `config show` keep working and preserve the offending entries verbatim. `config set`/`config get` do not support dotted keys into the query section; `config set` still rewrites the whole file and keeps the raw query section verbatim
- Before updating to a binary older than v0.1.2, remove the whole `[query]`, `[query.subqueries]`, and `[query.groups]` sections: older versions reject any non-empty query section (an empty `[query]` section is tolerated)
- The `config init` template ships the query section as commented examples only; the README configuration example shows them enabled for illustration
- Provider aliases affect only query-time display and aggregation: alias keys and values keep their case, leading and trailing whitespace is removed, and saved aliases use double-quoted TOML basic strings so keys such as `OpenCode-Completions` are consistently represented. They never alter stored messages or backfill historical empty provider values
- Newly collected records receive a source-based default provider when the client source is known: Codex uses `OpenAI`, Claude Code/Desktop uses `Anthropic`, and WorkBuddy uses `WorkBuddy`. Existing records with no provider remain unattributed
- ZCode provider names are read from its configuration (including names such as `OpenCode-Completions`) instead of falling back to provider UUIDs when the configuration supplies a name

### Installation
See the [README Quick Start](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage#quick-start). Existing users update in place with `token-usage update`; users on v0.1.2-rc.1 are upgraded to v0.1.2 by the same command.

<!-- zh -->
v0.1.2 是 token-usage 的第三个稳定版，完整汇总 v0.1.2-rc.1 以及其后 7 笔提交交付的全部变更；本稳定版发布后该预发布版即退役，本页为 v0.1.2 的权威记录。rc 用户可用 `token-usage update`（无需 `--version`）原地升级。

### 亮点
- 可配置查询视图，无需 SQL：把 `client`、`model`、`provider`、`project` 组合为具名多维子查询（至少两个维度，声明顺序即列顺序），把内置视图与子查询编排为按序输出的报告组合（至少两项，不能嵌套），并可设置个人默认视图——裸 `token-usage query` 直接执行它
- 视图像内置命令一样运行：`query <name> [日期]` 按位置参数分派（配置名称不会注册为动态子命令），`query custom <name> [日期]` 是等价显式写法——目标相同、输出相同、校验规则相同
- `query list` 是静态只读的发现命令：输出默认行为、六个内置命令，以及每个已配置子查询/组合的一条可复制命令及其维度或成员 CSV；只读取配置，绝不打开 usage 数据库
- config TUI 新增「查询视图」引导页（主菜单按 `v`），无需手写 CSV 即可创建子查询、组合报告与默认视图；raw 段无法解析时先显示恢复列表，逐项按 `enter` 修复
- 每条 query 命令现在以共享的双语统计信息区开头——统计范围、范围内最新消息时间（`数据截至`）与最近一次成功采集时间——多表组合也只打印一次；无数据的项显示 `—`
- 供应商维度（来自 v0.1.2-rc.1）：`query provider` 按供应商汇总用量，任意自定义视图都可包含 provider 维度，供应商别名是安全的仅展示映射

### 变更
- `query.default` 决定裸 `query` 的执行对象；未配置时等价按客户端分组。它可以引用内置视图、子查询或组合查询（`session` 与 `summary` 不可被引用）。视图名为小写标识符，且不能与 `client`/`model`/`provider`/`project`/`session`/`summary`/`custom`/`list` 冲突
- query 配置是纯展示配置且错误局部化：语义错误（断开引用、CSV 写错、未知键、`[query]` 与 `[Query]` 并存等顶层冲突）只使默认路径、具名调用、`query list` 与 TUI 保存失败，并定位到具体配置键。六个静态内置视图以及 `collect`、`status`、`start`、守护进程、`config set`、`config show` 不受影响，且原样保留问题项。`config set`/`config get` 不支持通过 dotted key 读写 query 段；`config set` 仍会整体重写配置文件并原样保留 raw query 段
- 升级到低于 v0.1.2 的版本前，请先删除整个 `[query]`、`[query.subqueries]`、`[query.groups]` 段：旧版本会拒绝任何非空 query 段（空 `[query]` 段可放行）
- `config init` 模板中 query 段仅以注释示例存在；README 的配置示例为演示而展示为启用形态
- 供应商别名只影响查询时的展示与聚合：别名 key 和 value 保留大小写、仅移除前后空白，保存时统一使用 TOML 双引号基本字符串（`OpenCode-Completions` 等 key 因此稳定呈现）。别名绝不修改已存储的消息，也不回填历史空供应商
- 新采集记录在客户端来源可确定时写入默认供应商：Codex 使用 `OpenAI`，Claude Code/Desktop 使用 `Anthropic`，WorkBuddy 使用 `WorkBuddy`。既有的空供应商记录仍保持未归因
- ZCode 从其配置读取供应商名称（包括 `OpenCode-Completions` 这类名称），配置提供名称时不再回退展示供应商 UUID

### 安装
见 [README 快速开始](https://github.com/YuLaiZ/token-usage/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#快速开始)。已有用户用 `token-usage update` 原地升级；处于 v0.1.2-rc.1 的用户执行同一命令即可升到 v0.1.2。
